business_problem: Processing billions of rows of data was a slow and complex task, requiring up to eight hours to generate reports.
solution_summary: Microsoft Finance built its Microsoft solution to improve enterprise data-platform modernization. Processing billions of rows of data was a slow and complex task, requiring up to eight hours to generate reports. Key components included Microsoft Fabric held and organized governed data, and Microsoft OneLake held and organized governed data. Operational data flows into Microsoft Fabric, where Microsoft Fabric applies transformations and business logic before Power BI delivers governed insights to teams across Microsoft Finance. The governed Microsoft stack gave Microsoft Finance a reusable foundation for data analytics, data platform while keeping deployment, security, and day-to-day operations inside the Microsoft estate. Reduced processing times by two-thirds.
